ticket.title: Garden Maintenance Request
ticket.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

input.subject: Reminder: garden request at Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk (ref R/PM019-1)
input.body:
Dear Jenkins,

Following up our email of 17 January about the garden at Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk, Alderwick, ZZ4 0ZZ (ref R/PM019-1).

The tenant has asked for the garden to be cleared of rubbish and construction waste, the ground levelled and covered with gravel so the space is safe and usable. No cost has been quoted yet.

Please could you let us know how you would like to proceed:
- Reply APPROVE if you would like us to arrange a contractor to attend and quote for the work (we will come back to you with the price before any work goes ahead);
- Reply DECLINE if you do not wish to carry out this work; or
- Let us know if you would prefer only part of the work (for example, removing the rubbish and construction waste) or will arrange it yourself.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings – Maintenance

input.subject: Your garden request – Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk (ref R/PM019-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your patience with your garden request at Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk, Alderwick, ZZ4 0ZZ (ref R/PM019-1). We have followed up with the landlord and are awaiting their decision.

The pictures you mentioned are not visible on our system. Could you please reply to this email with them attached? They will help the landlord decide and any contractor to price the work. If there is anything in the garden that is an immediate hazard (for example sharp debris or unstable materials), please let us know and keep clear of that area in the meantime.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings – Maintenance
